citation: Brown, Howard and Lundblad (2022, RFS 35(7)) Crowded trades and tail risk
formula: hf_crowd (to be an engine-only C++ kind, DEC-5, reusing lane AL-SIG's 13F reader): the share of a stock's 13F-reported holdings held by hedge-fund filers (Form ADV private-fund advisers joined to the 13F filer CIK), quarterly on the 13F clock of gia_13f; higher = more crowded among hedge funds
domain: NaN until the Form ADV join exists; then on the 13F stage's clock (13F from 2013q2)
deviation: the field is not built: the 13F books are in house, the hedge-fund flag of a filer is not (lit section 3.1 F2); BHL identify about 1,500 hedge funds directly, the house would use the Form ADV private-fund flag
notes: horizon class slow, half-life 63 sessions (PM8-5: quarterly holdings, the ownership_flow theme's); data class P; blocked_on_data: the Form ADV private-fund flag joined to the 13F filer CIK (lit section 6 row hf_crowd, P9DATA -> P9SIG); rho about .2 to momentum and inst_best_ideas (lit 3.1 F2), above the .1 bar, check against inst_best_ideas before any screen; PM ruling ALSIG-4: it stays a blocked_on_data registration and is never queued without a new PM ruling on the bar; AL-DATA (W3-18, ALD-5, 2026-10-04): design written, not built; the 2004-2016 source sample overlaps the OD-3 block; the house source would be the atx-db thirteenf_filer_type stage (filer_type_pit), which has no point-in-time fund-type input before 2023; the Form ADV join is deferred (al-data/atx-db-request.md, B2 dropped); design al-data/builder-designs.md section 2
predicted_mechanism: the stocks most crowded among hedge-fund longs carry the risk of a joint fire sale, and the crowded longs earn the highest returns as compensation for that tail risk
blocked_on: a hedge-fund flag per 13F filer: the SEC Form ADV private-fund adviser data joined to the 13F filer CIK
